ind.desc.3: Forced circulation evaporators, crystallizers, reactors, heat exchangers, and pressure vessels for chemical manufacturing.

indDetail.sub.0: Our flagship sector - complete end-to-end dairy process solutions
indDetail.sub.1: Hygienic process equipment for juice, starch, and food ingredient manufacturing
indDetail.sub.2: GMP-compliant sterile process equipment and systems
indDetail.sub.3: Robust process equipment for challenging chemical applications
indDetail.highlightDesc.0: Our multi-effect falling film evaporators achieve steam economies of 4 - 6 kg water per kg steam, reducing your energy costs by up to 60% compared to single-effect systems.
indDetail.note.0: Food processing demands strict hygienic design, easy cleanability, and consistent product quality. Our evaporators, dryers, and heat exchangers are built with SS 304/316L contact surfaces, sanitary fittings, and CIP integration to meet FSSAI and food-grade standards for juice, starch, glucose, and ingredient manufacturing.
indDetail.note.1: Chemical evaporation often involves corrosive, scaling, or crystallizing fluids. Our forced circulation evaporators maintain high liquid velocities to prevent fouling, while our material selection covers CS, SS, Hastalloy, Titanium, and rubber-lined options.

moreInd.desc.2: Black liquor multiple-effect evaporators, soap skimmer, condensate recovery, and heat integration for kraft pulp mills.
moreInd.desc.3: Textile effluent ZLD evaporators, salt recovery crystallizers, and MEE systems for dyeing and printing units.
